name: Sonnet contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Equal-weight basket of beaten-down names with identifiable 2026 catalysts: management/strategic resets, restructuring, product cycle reboots, or sector mean-reversion after heavy 2024-2025 selloffs.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: Each name suffered a multi-year drawdown into 2025 but carries a concrete 2026 catalyst: Intel's foundry/turnaround under new leadership, Paramount post-merger restructuring with Skydance, Nike's product/inventory reset under CEO Elliott Hill, Boeing's 737 MAX production ramp recovery, PayPal's Chriss-led reinvention, UPS's cost-cutting and Amazon volume reset, Estee Lauder's China/travel-retail stabilization, Starbucks' Niccol turnaround, Walgreens' post-buyout restructuring, and Disney's streaming profitability plus parks strength. This basket leans into deep value/mean-reversion rather than momentum, aiming to outperform if any subset of turnaround narratives inflects positively within six months.
